text:
Hi Ratu — you need a manufacturing website revamp that improves UI/UX, highlights the right content, and strengthens SEO.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can help redesign and rebuild PT. GIH’s site so it feels sharper, clearer, and easier for visitors to understand your capabilities.

In a recent project, I rebuilt a slow theme-based storefront for Juniper & Ash Home into a headless Next.js site with Tailwind CSS and Sanity, giving the marketing team control over content. The result was a drop in largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and a 38% increase in organic traffic within 3 months.

I’d be glad to discuss your current site and the key sections you want prioritized.
